response.justification: The candidate is a skilled full-stack and web/mobile software engineer with strong general software craftsmanship, but has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, or hardware-software co-design, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: Extensive and long professional software engineering experience across many domains
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems work (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Sociomantic
Strong track record of mentoring, teaching, and open-source contribution
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or chip architecture experience
No background in AI/deep-learning workload optimization or GPU/accelerator architecture
Career trajectory is entirely software/web/product focused, not hardware performance engineering

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator or GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture background
Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
